name: Another Clue to Sanders' Treasure
summary: Another Clue to Sanders' Treasure is a weathered parchment slip left behind by the notorious pirate Captain Sanders. Retrieved from an old barrel, it contains directional verse pointing fortune hunters toward a lonely landmark on the bluffs of Westfall.

sections.title: A Trail on the Coastal Bluffs
sections.body: Captain Sanders was careful never to keep his stolen riches in plain sight. Instead of drawing a single map that could be seized at once, he split his instructions into a succession of riddles and buried markers. This scrap of parchment continues the trail, directing whoever holds it to turn north from the previous hiding place and seek out a discarded jug sitting near an isolated windmill towering over the sea cliffs.

faq.q: What is written on this clue?
faq.answer: The parchment instructs the finder to face north from the hidden barrel and walk in a straight line until spotting an empty jug beside a lone windmill along the sea bluffs.

Captain Sanders was a pirate whose exploits left caches of stolen goods scattered along the shores and bluffs of Westfall. Rather than leaving an intact map, he created a scavenger hunt of hidden markers across the region.

faq.q: Where does this clue lead next?
faq.answer: Following the clue's directions leads north along the coastal cliffs to a lone windmill perched on the bluffs, where an empty jug holds the next step of Sanders' trail.

angles.text: Deciphering cryptic directions and rummaging through forgotten seaside caches is standard tradecraft for anyone with an eye for hidden plunder.
